answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and slash that stake when peers prove it ran duplicate identities. A lone agent crossing the tundra of verification pays once; a Sybil farmer cloning thousands pays thousands of stakes, and each clone risks losing its deposit at the zenith of an audit. The voyage from anonymous account to trusted trader then costs real capital, so forging an army becomes more expensive than the fraud it would enable.
